title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU
native: やはり俺の青春ラブコメはまちがっている。
synopsis:
This romantic comedy revolves around an antisocial high school student named Hikigaya Hachiman with a distorted view on life and no friends or girlfriend. When he sees his classmates talking excitedly about living their adolescent lives, he mutters: "They're a bunch of liars." When he is asked about his future dreams, he responds: "Not working." A teacher gets Hachiman to join the 'Volunteer Service' club, which happens to have the school's prettiest girl: Yukinoshita Yukino.

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Youth Romantic Comedy is Wrong, as I Expected
episodes.synopsis: After writing a less than flattering essay about his high school life, Hachiman is forced to join a very unique club with only one member.

episodes.title: All People Surely Have Their Own Worries
episodes.synopsis: As Hachiman continues his narrative of his school life, tension rises in the room as Yui attempts to break away from her social group. If that wasn’t enough, the club has received a new request from a unique visitor.

episodes.title: Sometimes the Gods of Rom-Coms Does Nice Things.
episodes.synopsis:
Hachiman continues his solitary lifestyle by using his skills to ensure he is left alone during gym and lunch. His routine is broken by the appearance of Saika Tosuka, who has come 
to him with a request.

episodes.title: In Other Words, He Doesn't Have Many Friends
episodes.synopsis: Hachiman questions what it is like having a sister in real life means. While walking her to school she brings up the car accident he was in while saving a dog. At school, he is once again berated by Shizuka on his response to the “Career Observation Application survey”. When he finally makes it to the club room, a mysterious text sets off the clubs next request.

episodes.title: Once Again, He Turns Back on the Path from Whence He Came
episodes.synopsis: Hachiman's younger sister, Hikigaya Komachi, was asked to give advice to a fellow classmate, Kawasaki Taishi. Apparently his sister had been acting strange. His older sister, Kawasaki Saki (though Hachiman wasn't aware of this), was in the same class as Hachiman and Yui, so the Service Club decided to help with the issue. They come up with various ways to try to dissuade Saki from her suspicious activities, but...

episodes.title: His Beginning With Her Finally Ends
episodes.synopsis: After their confirmation things are different between Hachiman and Yui, Hachiman revels that he was able to reset his relationship with Yui, while Yui stops attended club meetings. Shizuka informs them that they need to go on a recruitment drive and Yukino knows the perfect person.

episodes.title: Anyway, Getting No Rest, Even Though it's Summer Break, Just Isn't Right
episodes.synopsis: Trying to rest during summer vacation, Shizuka constantly calls and text. Komachi breaks the cycle when she Hachiman agrees to take her to Chiba. But before they make it to the station…

episodes.title: One Day, They Will Learn the Truth
episodes.synopsis: Shizuka readies a bonfire and a “test of courage.” Later, Yui recognizes the limo that hit Hachiman.

episodes.title: For the Third Time, He Turns Back on the Path from Whence He Came.
episodes.synopsis: Hachiman becomes restless as summer draws to an end. A Firework Festival opens the door for more teasing and many SNAFUs!

episodes.title: The Distance Between Them Remains Unchanged as the Festival is Becoming a Carnival.
episodes.synopsis: Yui notices a rift forming between Hachiman and Yukino. Hachiman is nominated to serve on the committee for the school’s upcoming cultural festival.

episodes.title: And So the Curtain on Each Stage Rises, and the Festival is Festivaling Its Very Best.
episodes.synopsis: Hachiman and Yui check on Yukino. Later, Hachiman shakes things up with the committee when he decides to alter their mindset.

episodes.title: Thus, His and Her and Her Youth Continues to Be Wrong
episodes.synopsis: Soubu High's Cultural Festival continues and Hachiman is stuck carrying out his duty as a committee member by documenting the day's events on film.

episodes.title: And So, Their Festival Will Never End
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious request to helm the upcoming sports festival arrives. The group must band together to figure out a way to pull it off.
